title: Bookmarks
subtitle: Design your own bookmark from your picture, from a pattern, or as a whole set. You see it straight away, and we 3D print it.

picture.heading: Picture
picture.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to {maxMb} MB. The picture stays in your browser and is not uploaded anywhere.
picture.tooLarge: The picture is over {maxMb} MB. Choose a smaller one.
picture.wrongType: That file is not a JPG, PNG or WebP.
picture.needed: Upload a picture to see your bookmark.

colours.heading: Colours
colours.hintPicture: Picked from your picture. Change any of them freely.
colours.hintPattern: How many colours you need depends on the pattern style.

set.heading: Set
set.splitHint: The picture is split across the bookmarks, so together they make one big picture.
set.picturesHint: Up to {max} bookmarks, each with its own picture. Add the pictures one by one: all of them show in the preview.
set.namesHint: The same design for all, with a different name on each bookmark.

privacy.heading: Your picture stays with you
privacy.text: The picture is processed in your browser, never uploaded or stored, and disappears when you close the page. The order only sends a file with your settings and a simplified few-colour version of the picture, together with your contact details.
